title: Is ModExp gas computed before memory allocation?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: The target repository is OffchainLabs/prysm at commit 238d5c07df, an Ethereum consensus layer (beacon chain) client written in Go. Exhaustive search across all Go source files in target_workspace confirmed zero occurrences of ModExp, modexp, or EIP-2565 gas calculation logic. The beacon chain client handles consensus-layer concerns (attestations, validator management, fork choice) and delegates execution-layer concerns to the execution engine via Engine API. ModExp (EIP-198/EIP-2565) is a precompile at address 0x05 in the EVM, exclusively handled by execution clients such as go-ethereum, reth, or besu.
